title: busbar.conformance.verdict/1
description: One suite's arm-or-red fact, as its rig judged it. Each repo's ModernCI `conformance` check (testing/conformance/run.sh) writes one `<suite>.json` per suite it ran, stamped with its repo, commit and core pin; `scripts/conformance/import.sh` brings them here and `python3 scripts/conformance/sync.py --write` renders the manifest. Every verdict is held to this schema before it is read, and a verdict whose `suite` is not the id it is filed under is refused. A registered suite with no verdict file is not-run, never green. Rules: armed==false requires status "not-run", so status "pass" requires armed==true; `commit` is the sha the SUBJECT was built from, which is what makes staleness detectable.

suite.description: Stable suite id, matching the registry and the file's own name.

commit.description: The sha the subject was built from: the judged commit of `repo`.

repo.description: The repo whose check judged the suite (owner/name); its freshness is judged against that repo's dev head.

core_pin.description: The busbar core sha the subject was built against (a plugin's .busbar-ref pin; busbar's own HEAD for a core suite).

cert_id.description: certified tier only: the issued cert id.

issuer.description: certified tier only: the body that issued it.

expires.description: certified tier only: cert validity end.
